description: Every failure the engine can produce, enumerated. A slot is one (command, status) pair -- the unit session.signature_of keys strikes on, and therefore the unit that can earn a hint. Decorators split one slot into several lessons; they never create new slots. This file is the worklist for authoring hints and the source of truth for the coverage test in tests/templates/. Adding a command means adding its slots here in the same change. A decorator implied by the status itself (target_exists on a Not_Found, target_is_file on a Not_A_Directory) is deliberately not listed: it discriminates nothing and only inflates the specificity score that decides precedence.

decorators.target_exists: The first argument resolves to a node in the VFS.
decorators.target_is_file: The first argument resolves to a file rather than a directory.
decorators.cwd_has_children: The directory the child is standing in contains anything at all.
decorators.target_near_sibling: A sibling of the cwd has a name within edit distance 2 of what was typed -- the typo case.
decorators.target_in_parent: The name that was not found here does exist one level up -- the wrong-room case.
decorators.cwd_is_root: The child is at the top of the tree, so there is no further up to go.
decorators.target_is_empty_dir: The first argument resolves to a directory with nothing in it.
decorators.argv_count: How many arguments the verb was given. An integer, not a boolean.

slots.stderr: flish: cd: expected one folder name
flish: cd: {target}: No such file or directory
slots.concept: the name does not exist here

slots.stderr: flish: ls: cannot access '{target}': No such file or directory
slots.concept: the name does not exist here

slots.stderr: flish: cat: expected one file name
flish: cat: {target}: No such file or directory
slots.concept: the name does not exist here
the verb itself is not a command
slots.note: command is empty because this slot matches any unrecognised verb. A template for it leaves match.command unset.

forbidden_vocabulary.note: Engineering vocabulary from the matcher, rejected in hint bodies. A seven year old does not read these. 'directory' is deliberately absent: it is the word the authentic error uses, so the child has already seen it and the hint should echo it. Slots whose concept is argument count are the hard case -- say what the child typed or did not type, not that a verb 'expects one argument'.
